meta.subject: Social Science
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Standard Six Social Science Term I 2025 English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive bilingual framing from prose, infobits, excavation map, Sources of History diagram, Ashoka case study, summary, glossary, exercises, HOTS, activities, answer grid, map work and ICT. Outside answers are not silently inserted.
source_notes: The English and Tamil editions have different printed page numbering and a slightly different ordering around proto-history/Ashoka; each question stores separate English and Tamil page references.
The Sources of History diagram was read visually to capture artefacts, inscription types, monuments, secular literature and religious literature that are incompletely represented in parsed text.
The excavation map is used only for clearly readable site names and age symbols; ambiguous marker/category combinations are not invented.
The exercise fill-in asking for the 'father of history' is not answered from outside knowledge because the lesson text shown in this unit does not supply that answer.
Where printed matching blocks are visually crossed/misaligned, the bank answers from the lesson/diagram rather than treating layout adjacency as an answer key.
